AI & Marketing Concepts

Predictive Loyalty

Using AI to identify high-potential future loyal customers and proactively engage them before loyalty solidifies.

Explanation

Predictive Loyalty shifts focus from rewarding past loyalty to forecasting and nurturing future loyalty. Marty Kihn, SVP of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, explained on Decoding AI for Marketers episode 13 that loyalty is about predicting the future, not rewarding the past. AI evaluates behavioral signals like purchase frequency, spend, engagement, and cart abandonment to assign loyalty scores. Marketers then deploy personalized campaigns before loyalty forms, growing the base of future loyalists and increasing customer lifetime value while optimizing loyalty budgets.

Usage context / examples

An AI model identifies a customer who visits frequently, engages with content, but hasn't purchased. Before they leave, the brand sends a personalized offer designed to convert them into a long-term loyal customer.

Related terms

Brand as Performance (BaP), CAP (Consortium for AI Personalization), MMGF (Movable Middles Growth Framework)
